rymesh — 多 Agent Web 控制台（Codex CLI / Cla:
rymesh — a web console for several agents (Codex CLI / Claude Code)

Usage:
  rymesh client              start the console on this machine (configures itself and registers the background service the first time) and open it in the browser, signed in
  rymesh client open         open this machine's console in the browser
  rymesh node setup ...      install or upgrade the node here (usually run by a client over SSH)
  rymesh node token|add|list manage the node token and remote devices
  rymesh install [options]   on a server: write the config, install the systemd unit, enable and start it
  rymesh serve               run the web service in the foreground (used by systemd)
  rymesh status              show the service, agents, tasks and conversations
  rymesh import              import native Codex / Claude history again
  rymesh tasks [--all]       list tasks
  rymesh cancel <task-id>    cancel a task
  rymesh logs [-n 100]       show the service log
  rymesh doctor              check the environment
  rymesh version             show the version

install options:
  --config PATH       config file (default /etc/rymesh/config.json)
  --port PORT         listening port (default 8899)
  --data DIR          data directory (default /var/lib/rymesh)
  --log DIR           log directory (default /var/log/rymesh)
  --no-start          only write the config and the systemd unit, do not start

Security:
  - No password login: the Mac / Android apps and rymesh client open sign in with a one-time ticket;
    a hub reaches a node with the node's token.
  - Listens only on 127.0.0.1 and the EasyTier interface address, never on 0.0.0.0.
  - The agents' permission requests and questions appear on the page, where you allow once, allow for the session,
    always allow or deny, as in the CLI in a terminal.

用法:\n rymesh client 启动（首次自动配置）:
Usage:
  rymesh client          start (configures itself the first time) and open in the browser
  rymesh client open     open in the browser (signed in)
  rymesh client stop     stop the console (running agent tasks are not affected)
  rymesh client serve    run in the foreground (for a service manager)
用法:\n rymesh node setup --token 令牌 [--p:
Usage:
  rymesh node setup --token TOKEN [--port 8899] [--name NAME]  install or upgrade the node here (~/.rymesh, listens on 127.0.0.1 only)
  rymesh node token [--rotate]                       show this machine's node token (created the first time)
  rymesh node name <NAME>                            set this machine's name in the device list
  rymesh node add <id> --name NAME --url URL --token TOKEN  add a remote device (run on the hub)
  rymesh node remove <id>                            remove a remote device
  rymesh node list                                   list remote devices
All subcommands take --config; restart the service for changes to take effect.
用法: rymesh node add <id> --name 名称 --url: Usage: rymesh node add <id> --name NAME --url URL --token TOKEN
